entries.key: §8§oMidas' most prized possession - a gift from his older brother, whose boundless generosity got the better of him. While he always admired his brother, Midas swore his kingdom would not end the same way.

entries.value: §8§o無論你從哪個角度看，都找不到愛。

entries.key: §8§oOne of the greatest minds of his time. Much can be learned from what Daedalus left behind.

entries.key: §8§oRewarded to every Necromancer who passes the final exam.

entries.key: §8§oSome people say it is harder than diamond. Hard to tell, really.
